title: Cue Sheet — Example Workshop
subtitle: A one-day, invented example event for the inscribe workshop format; every name, text, minute and colour below is fabricated for this example instance (issue #103) and is not drawn from any real event.

cues.name: Opening
cues.what: Guests arrive and find a seat; a placeholder shape is shown at each spot.
cues.Wall: A soft grid across every wall, no names yet.
cues.Floor: Matching grid underfoot with one shape per seat.
cues.Facilitation: Welcomes guests and invites them to sit anywhere.
cues.Operator: Waits until the room has settled, then advances the cue.
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).

cues.name: Connecting
cues.what: A join code appears at every seat so phones can connect.
cues.Wall: Join code fades in per seat.
cues.Floor: Shape stays, join code added beside it.
cues.Facilitation: Helps anyone whose phone has not connected yet.
cues.Operator: Confirms every seat shows as connected before advancing.
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).

cues.name: Finding Roles
cues.what: Each phone reveals an invented role card for its seat.
cues.Phone: shows the seat's invented role card
cues.Facilitation: Invites guests to read their own card quietly.
cues.Operator: Advances once everyone has their card.
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).

cues.name: Introductions
cues.what: Each table introduces its invented roles to one another.
cues.Facilitation: Prompts each table to go around once.
cues.Operator: Advances once the round of introductions has settled.
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).

cues.name: Transition
cues.what: A short beat while the room resets for the first exchange.
cues.Phone: shows a short countdown bar, no digits
cues.Facilitation: Stands back, lets the pause land.
cues.Operator: Advances when the pause has run its course.
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).

cues.name: Exchange I
cues.what: Tables hold their first open exchange; each table's own capture starts.
cues.Wall: A faint listening indicator per table.
cues.Phone: shows a running countdown bar, no digits
cues.Operator: Advances once every table has had its turn to speak.
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).

cues.name: Reset
cues.what: A short beat between the two exchange rounds.
cues.Phone: shows a short countdown bar, no digits
cues.Facilitation: Invites a brief stretch before the next round.
cues.Operator: Advances when the room is ready again.
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).

cues.name: Exchange II
cues.what: A second, deeper exchange round; tables may raise their own follow-up question.
cues.Phone: shows a running countdown bar, plus an optional own-question prompt
cues.Operator: Advances once the second round has run its course.
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).

cues.name: Prologue
cues.what: Each table receives a short written prologue drawn from its own exchange.
cues.Phone: shows the table's own prologue text as it is written
cues.Facilitation: Reads along quietly with each table.
cues.Operator: Advances once every table's prologue has finished writing.
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).

cues.name: Pause
cues.what: A short beat before the room comes back together for feedback.
cues.Phone: shows a short countdown bar, no digits
cues.Facilitation: Stands back, lets the pause land.
cues.Operator: Advances when the room is ready to reconvene.
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).

cues.name: Feedback
cues.what: Tables take turns sharing back to the whole room, one at a time.
cues.Phone: shows whose turn it is to speak
cues.Facilitation: Hands the room queue to each table in turn.
cues.Operator: Advances once every table has shared.
cues.Mic: on, one table at a time
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).

cues.name: Closing
cues.what: A closing word to the whole room; the last cue is held until guests leave.
cues.Facilitation: Closes the event and thanks everyone.
cues.Operator: Holds this cue open; nothing further to advance.
cues.notes: Example data only, fabricated for the template test (issue #103).
